public_rationale: Marcus bet that AGI superior to the smartest individual humans would not arrive by the end of 2025, and said one piece of intellectual work that the best humans can do and AI cannot would settle it. On 5 December 2025 the best verified AI systems solved 37.6% and 54% of ARC-AGI-2 tasks. Every task in that set had been solved by at least two people in two attempts or less.
limitations: The AI measurement is dated 5 December 2025, not 31 December 2025. A result published between those dates is not covered.
ARC-AGI-2 is one task set. This record does not assess whether any system met anyone's definition of AGI on other tasks.
The 54% result uses a refinement harness around Gemini 3 Pro. The best single commercial model scored 37.6%.
Treating ARC-AGI-2 as 'intellectual work' that settles the bet is our interpretation of Marcus's stated test.

criteria.contradiction_condition: By 2025-12-31 an AI system could do any intellectual work that any human can do, so that no task set was left where humans succeed and AI fails.
